title: Coverage Term Schedule by Make for the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage
content:
# Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage — Coverage Term Schedule by Make

Each coverage type of the Warranty and Safety Recall Coverage has a term in months and a term in miles that depend on the make of the vehicle (Toyota, Honda, Ford, Chevrolet or Hyundai), or, for a coverage counted in days, a term in days. The schedule below sets those figures for every coverage type and names the date and odometer from which each term counts.

## Schedule notes

- **Term months.** The months of coverage for the make. A figure of 0 means the make does not offer the coverage (or, for the dealer's warranty, that the term in days applies).
- **Term miles.** The miles of coverage for the make. A figure of 0 means no mileage limit.
- **Term days.** The term in days for a coverage counted in days; 0 for a coverage counted in months.
- **Term start.** The date and odometer the term counts from: the in-service date with an odometer of 0, or the delivery date with the delivery odometer.

## Term months by make

| Coverage type | Toyota | Honda | Ford | Chevrolet | Hyundai |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 24 | 0 | 0 | 12 | 36 |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 36 | 36 | 36 | 36 | 60 |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 120 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 84 | 84 | 84 | 72 | 120 |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 96 | 96 | 96 | 96 | 96 |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |

## Term miles by make

| Coverage type | Toyota | Honda | Ford | Chevrolet | Hyundai |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 1,000 | 1,000 | 1,000 | 1,000 | 1,000 |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 25,000 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 36,000 |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 36,000 | 36,000 | 36,000 | 36,000 | 60,000 |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 60,000 | 60,000 | 60,000 | 60,000 | 100,000 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 100,000 | 100,000 | 100,000 | 100,000 | 100,000 |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 80,000 | 80,000 | 80,000 | 80,000 | 80,000 |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Term in days and term start

| Coverage type | Term days | Term counts from |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty | 30 | delivery date, with the delivery odometer |
| Factory Complimentary Maintenance | 0 | in-service date, with odometer 0 |
| Factory Basic Limited Warranty | 0 | in-service date, with odometer 0 |
| Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty | 0 | in-service date, with odometer 0 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Powertrain Warranty | 0 | in-service date, with odometer 0 |
| Federal Emissions Performance Warranty | 0 | in-service date, with odometer 0 |
| Safety Recall Remedy Coverage | 0 | in-service date, with odometer 0 |

## Reading the schedule

- The Kessler Used Vehicle Limited Warranty is the one coverage counted in days: 30 days and 1,000 miles for every make, counted from the delivery date and the delivery odometer.
- A Honda or Ford shows 0 term months and 0 term days under Factory Complimentary Maintenance, so those makes do not offer that coverage.
- A Chevrolet's Factory Complimentary Maintenance runs 12 months with 0 term miles, that is, with no mileage limit; the Safety Recall Remedy Coverage likewise has no mileage limit for any make.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A Hyundai delivered new, with an in-service date D: its Factory Powertrain Limited Warranty counts 120 months from D and 100,000 miles from an odometer of 0, while its Factory Basic Limited Warranty counts 60 months and 60,000 miles from the same date and odometer.
